title: Independent degree-100 cyclic components with signed intersections and radius 20

claims.statement: The explicit product of two five-field degree-100 cyclic codes with the fixed radius-20 adaptive list decoder has average block error at most 76372474016120469/200000000000000000 on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) channel uses with uniform 1000-bit input.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=1647025811321347888401248771864 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(50189/500).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles, field, orbits and primitive bound (0), all 33 averaged pair cutoffs with exact signed shell sums (1), 126 exact child-removal shells (2), and the final cumulative two-component error (3).
